“I support the normal people. What you call the far right, falsely.”
Then he turned it around and pointed out that hundreds of millions of people actually agree with him while legacy media is the one bleeding trust.
No apologies. No walking anything back. Just pure clarity and zero tolerance for the narrative games.

BREAKING: Tesla is making a strong comeback across Europe. 🇪🇺

• Registrations across the EU, UK, and EFTA surged more than 50% year over year in June, exceeding 51,000 vehicles.
• The Model Y led the market with 34,050 registrations, up 37.9%.
• Model Y was Europe's best-selling vehicle in June, beating every EV, hybrid, and gas car.
• It outsold the second-place Dacia Sandero by nearly 8,600 units.

First-half 2026 highlights:
• Tesla registrations reached around 170,000.
• Model Y sales climbed 59% year over year.
• Model Y ranked as Europe's No. 2 best-selling vehicle in H1, fewer than 2,500 registrations behind the Dacia Sandero.

The refreshed Model Y isn't just leading the EV market—it is now competing to become Europe's best-selling vehicle of 2026.

ELON SHUTS DOWN THE “DOGE KILLED PEOPLE” NARRATIVE

In the Economist interview, the editor pushed the claim that DOGE cuts to USAID caused deaths.

Elon’s response was direct:
“Zero.”

When pressed further, he said the claims are “false… nonsense and absolute nonsense.”
He pointed out that legitimate programs were moved to the State Department, and that when you stop funding fraudulent or ineffective organizations, the people who lost the money never admit it was waste — they invent the most sympathetic story possible to get the funding restored.
That’s exactly what happened.
The media ran with the emotional narrative. Elon stuck to the facts.

Video

. @elonmusk DESTROYS THE “FAR RIGHT” SMEAR
In the Economist interview, the editor tried the usual line:

“You support the far right…”

Elon’s response was perfect:

“No, I support the normal people. What you call the far right, falsely.”
He then listed three basic positions:
•  Secure borders
•  Safe cities
•  Sensible spending
And asked: “Which of those three are far right fringe?”
He went further:
“I would like to just admonish you and the media for the absurd characterization of the far right. It is false and misleading and nonsense.”
That’s the entire game right there. Take completely mainstream positions that were normal 10–15 years ago, rebrand them as “far right,” and then act shocked when people push back.
Elon refused to play along. He called it what it is — a dishonest framing designed to shut down debate.
The more the media overuses these labels, the less power they have.
